endorsements.name: miaubiz
endorsements.label: Put on your tinfo_t hat if you're my type
endorsements.description: The IDA Pro APIs for interacting with type information are full of opportunities (horrible problems). I will show you how to create unparseable types, how to apply these types to functions and variables and how to transfer these types from one IDB to another.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 23
